001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonToken;
007import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
008import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
009import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.io.InputStream;
012import java.io.OutputStream;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * JSON Walker for applying transformations to JSON data.
018 *
019 * <p>This command navigates through JSON structures and applies transformations using rules while
020 * preserving the overall JSON structure.
021 *
022 * <p>Responsibilities: - Navigate to specified JSON paths - Apply transformation rules to matching
023 * elements - Preserve JSON structure during transformation - Stream processing for memory
024 * efficiency
025 */
026public class JsonWalker implements IStreamCommand {
027
028  private final TreePath treePath;
029  private final IRule rule;
030  private final JsonFactory jsonFactory;
031
032  /**
033   * Constructor for JSON navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
034   *
035   * @param treePath the TreePath to select data
036   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
037   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
038   */
039  private JsonWalker(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
040    this.treePath = treePath;
041    this.rule = rule;
042    this.jsonFactory = new JsonFactory();
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Factory method for creating a JSON navigation command with TreePath and rule.
047   *
048   * @param treePath the TreePath to select data
049   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
050   * @return a JsonWalker that transforms the specified path with the given rule
051   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
052   */
053  public static JsonWalker create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
054    if (treePath == null) {
055      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
056    }
057    if (rule == null) {
058      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
059    }
060    return new JsonWalker(treePath, rule);
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
065    processJsonWithStreaming(inputStream, outputStream);
066  }
067
068  /** Stream JSON processing with structure preservation */
069  private void processJsonWithStreaming(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
070      throws IOException {
071    try (JsonParser parser = jsonFactory.createParser(inputStream);
072        JsonGenerator generator = jsonFactory.createGenerator(outputStream)) {
073
074      // Process with JSONPath filtering - transform matching elements
075      processJsonStreamWithPath(parser, generator);
076
077      generator.flush();
078    }
079  }
080
081  /** Process JSON with specific JSONPath targeting */
082  private void processJsonStreamWithPath(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator)
083      throws IOException {
084    int depth = 0;
085    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
086    JsonToken token;
087    while ((token = parser.nextToken()) != null) {
088      switch (token) {
089        case FIELD_NAME -> depth = handleFieldName(parser, generator, depth, currentPath);
090        case VALUE_STRING -> handleValueString(parser, generator, currentPath);
091        case START_OBJECT -> {
092          depth++;
093          generator.writeStartObject();
094        }
095        case END_OBJECT -> depth = handleEndObject(generator, depth, currentPath);
096        case START_ARRAY -> generator.writeStartArray();
097        case END_ARRAY -> generator.writeEndArray();
098        default -> generator.copyCurrentEvent(parser);
099      }
100    }
101  }
102
103  private int handleFieldName(
104      JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, int depth, List<String> currentPath)
105      throws IOException {
106    String fieldName = parser.currentName();
107    while (currentPath.size() < depth) {
108      currentPath.add(null);
109    }
110    while (currentPath.size() > depth) {
111      currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
112    }
113    if (depth > 0) {
114      currentPath.set(depth - 1, fieldName);
115    }
116    generator.writeFieldName(fieldName);
117    return depth;
118  }
119
120  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
121  private void handleValueString(
122      JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, List<String> currentPath) throws IOException {
123    // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions; RuntimeException catch wraps any rule failure.
124    String originalValue = parser.getText();
125    if (isMatchingPath(currentPath)) {
126      String transformed;
127      try {
128        transformed = rule.apply(originalValue);
129      } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
130        throw new IOException("Rule application failed at path " + currentPath, ruleEx);
131      }
132      generator.writeString(transformed);
133    } else {
134      generator.writeString(originalValue);
135    }
136  }
137
138  private int handleEndObject(JsonGenerator generator, int depth, List<String> currentPath)
139      throws IOException {
140    int newDepth = depth - 1;
141    while (currentPath.size() > newDepth) {
142      currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
143    }
144    generator.writeEndObject();
145    return newDepth;
146  }
147
148  /** Simple path matching for streaming JSON processing */
149  private boolean isMatchingPath(List<String> currentPath) {
150    // Use matchesIgnoringArraySyntax so that paths like $.orders[*].product_code
151    // correctly match the streaming currentPath ["orders", "product_code"].
152    return treePath.matchesIgnoringArraySyntax(currentPath);
153  }
154}
